newsitem.title: USA: At least nine dead in Texas tornado - police.
newsitem.headline: At least nine dead in Texas tornado - police.

text.p: At least nine people were killed on Tuesday when a tornado ripped through the small town of Jarrell, Texas, about 60 miles north of Austin, police said.
"There are nine confirmed dead, possibly more," said Texas Department of Public Safety spokeswoman Sherri Deatherage Green.
Deatherage Green said it was not yet known how or where the victims died, but said the twister "went very near Interstate 35 for a while and stopped southbound traffic."
She said there were also reports of people missing in a grocery store just north of Austin where the roof collapsed when it was hit by a tornado.
Also a shopping mall and housing development in the area were struck, but officials said it was not yet known how many people were injured or how many buildings were damaged.
Deatherage Green said police were urging people still at work not to drive home because of the spring storms plaguing central Texas and not to enter buildings damaged by the tornados.
